Homestead lecture
[00:00:00] Homestead in this state does three different jobs, and students mix them up.
[00:00:12] First, protection from forced sale. Creditors generally cannot force the sale of the homestead, with exceptions such as taxes, the purchase money mortgage, and improvements.
[00:00:31] The size limits are one-half acre inside a municipality and 160 acres outside a municipality.
[00:00:44] Second, the tax exemption and the save our homes cap on assessed value.
[00:00:58] Third, the restriction on devise. An owner survived by a spouse or a minor child cannot freely devise the homestead.
[00:01:15] And to convey or mortgage the homestead, the spouse must join in the deed even if the spouse is not on title.
[00:01:30] Now a quick word on recording. Our recording act is a notice statute, so a bona fide purchaser for value without notice wins even if they record second.
[00:01:48] And remember the marketable record title act with its 30 years root of title.
